other_conditions: All regular State Government employees and provincialised employees of local bodies are eligible
All retired service pensioners, family pensioners, and re‑employed service pensioners are eligible
Dependent family members of employees and pensioners are eligible
The scheme applies to both serving and retired employees of the state government of Andhra Pradesh
benefits_summary: Provides cashless hospitalization and outpatient care up to Rs 2 lakhs per episode, with ward benefits based on pay grade.
